title: My Brother Forged A $1 Note, Stole Dad's $195K Collection, And Sold It. So I Let Him Dust It.
description: After my brother forged a $1 note to steal our late father's signed first-edition Southern Gothic novels worth $195K and sold them for $230K, I found proof hidden in a hollowed-out copy of As I Lay Dying and took him to probate court. Now I run 'Plot Twist Books' where he dusts shelves in a vest reading 'Chapter of Forged Lies' and every sale includes a bookmark exposing his fraud. #BookTok #RevengeStory #PlotTwistBooks
thumb_text: HE SOLD DAD'S BOOKS FOR $230K, NOW HE DUSTS THEM
pinned_comment: If my brother forged a $1 note to steal Dad's $195K book collection, would you have opened a bookstore and made him dust shelves in that vest? Share your story in the comments if a family member ever betrayed you like this.

thumb_lines.text: FOUND PROOF OF FORGERY IN A HOLLOWED-OUT COPY OF AS I LAY DYING
